Open calls - HORIZON-NEB-2026-01 (Horizon Europe, NEB Facility). Deadline: 01/12/2026.
HORIZON-NEB-2026-01-PARTICIPATION-03 - Understanding inhabitant's experiences of neighbourhoods to support their health and well-being - RIA - Indicative budget €15 million - Expected EU contribution per project €5 million
HORIZON-NEB-2026-01-BUSINESS-03 - Approaches to reuse vacant, obsolete or underutilised spaces - RIA - Indicative budget €9 million - Expected EU contribution per project €4.5 million
HORIZON-NEB-2026-01-PARTICIPATION-02 - Innovative approaches for the spatial design of neighbourhoods - IA - Indicative budget €10 million - Expected EU contribution per project €5 million
HORIZON-NEB-2026-01-BUSINESS-01 - Structurally addressing homelessness through coordinated social infrastructure and services in neighbourhoods - IA - Indicative budget €10.5 million - Expected EU contribution per project €3.50 million
HORIZON-NEB-2026-01-PARTICIPATION-01 - Addressing homelessness through housing-led approaches aligned with the New European Bauhaus - IA - Indicative budget €12.6 million - Expected EU contribution per project €6.30 million
HORIZON-NEB-2026-01-REGEN-01 - Sustainable, inclusive, affordable and beautiful solutions for thermal comfort in buildings - IA - Indicative budget €12 million - Expected EU contribution per project €4 million
HORIZON-NEB-2026-01-BUSINESS-02 - Understanding capital market dynamics for increased investment in New European Bauhaus projects in neighbourhoods - RIA - Indicative budget €7 million - Expected EU contribution per project €3.5 million
HORIZON-NEB-2026-01-REGEN-02 - Advancing sustainable maintenance and repair measures for existing buildings - IA - Indicative budget €10 million - Expected EU contribution per project €5 million
HORIZON-NEB-2026-01-REGEN-03 - Innovative solutions for the sustainable and beautiful use of vertical space - IA - Indicative budget €15 million - Expected EU contribution per project €5 million

### Documento oficial (copiado por la tarea): https://new-european-bauhaus.europa.eu/calls-proposals/structurally-addressing-homelessness-through-coordinated-social-infrastructure-and-services_en
HORIZON-NEB-2026-01-BUSINESS-01. Deadline: 1 December 2026, 17:00 (CET). Single-stage. Type of action: Innovation Actions (HORIZON-IA).
The approach should be developed and validated in at least five neighbourhoods located in different Member States and/or Associated Countries.

### Documento oficial (copiado por la tarea): https://sciencebusiness.net/sites/default/files/inline-files/HORIZON-General-annexes-2026-2027_05_18_2026.pdf
Horizon Europe Work Programme 2026-2027 - General Annexes (fragmentos).
Annex B - Eligibility: Any legal entity, regardless of its place of establishment, [...] is eligible to participate (whether it is eligible for funding or not), [...]
Consortium composition: [...] three legal entities independent from each other and each established in a different country [...]: at least one independent legal entity established in a Member State; and at least two other independent legal entities, each established in different Member States or Associated Countries. Affiliated entities do not count toward this minimum.
Funding rates: Research and innovation action: 100%. Innovation action: 70% (except for non-profit legal entities, where a rate of up to 100% applies).
